text_block_list.text:
"New Year's Day is the day to make the year's plans." So with that in mind,
I went for the first shrine visit of the year with Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, let us pray with all our might!
Even in the Senior year, hustle and muscle!!
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm in the Senior class starting this year,
so I figured I couldn't let myself be beat in spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Arima Kinen at the end of last year,
I really felt it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She said the Senior Class is like a "vast ocean."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't go in with a strong mindset, I'll be pushed right back.
I won't be able to move forward at all. So—!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I think this Hatsumode is really important! I've gotta set some solid goals."

"The now-dependable Mejiro Ryan
seems ready to take on the year with great ambition."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even when you say 'properly,' I think there are
many ways to set goals. I'd also like to do something
about my weaknesses in my private life."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So please make it extra tough! Something I can't
overcome without flexing my mental muscles to the max!

A strict goal, huh?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-You're really going there!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Romance... That's my biggest weakness of all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then for our very first film of the New Year, I'll challenge a romance movie!
I'll watch it all the way to the end without getting embarrassed!
...And so, we came to watch a romance movie together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I-It's finally starting...!
*Thump-thump, thump-thump*... Eeeeeek~♪)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(There's no way I can look right at it.
I'll just close my eyes for a bit...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, will you listen to me?
Um... I love you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together up to that furlong pole!
You're great at right-handed turns, Senpai~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufufufu...♪
*kuka~, kuka~*...

Dozing off with her mouth wide open...
Having slept like a log, her energy seems to have recovered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "True wish discovered... It's true, right now, I might have lost sight of my goal."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Classic races I longed for are over,and I even got to fulfill my match against McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mmm, let me think... Trainer, could you give me the day to think it over?
That night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
I just can't make up my mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm having a hard time picking. There are so many big races,
and McQueen and Oguri-san are there too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Could we hold off on deciding for now?
I want to try chasing after all of them."
choice_data_list: Chasing after all of them is going to be tough, you know?
Chasing after all of them is going to be tough, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm fully prepared! No matter how hard it gets, I'll thoroughly prepare until it's decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone
who can properly chase after any dream!

I've resolved to prepare for every possible future.
This should allow for well-rounded growth in all directions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"A revolution...? That's a tough order.
Not just training, but a revolution, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I was only thinking
about straightforward improvements. I need to broaden my scope...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, let's play basketball,
basketball!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll try a different move than usual!
Pivot into a layup shot.
I'll sink it in a clean rhythm!"

Mejiro Ryan moves around swiftly and nimbly.
It seems she gained quite a few ideas
from basketball footwork.
